title: Rollout Inspector: Annotative Feedback Workflow & Visual Systems Review
creator: Lena Cho
description: Create and validate a visual and interaction system for the new Rollout Inspector in the Console that lets product and SRE stakeholders leave persistent, context-aware annotations tied to rollout events. This ticket covers high-fidelity prototype reviews, redlines for dev handoff, accessibility contrast/focus states, microcopy for annotations, and an acceptance QA checklist. Goal: reduce follow-up design clarifications during dev by 70% and surface clear remediation actions for failed rollouts in the UI.
acceptance_criteria: Handoff-ready Figma frames with exportable tokens and annotated redlines for all inspector states (idle, annotating, resolved, flagged)
Contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for badges (or approved exceptions documented)
Keyboard-only flows for creating/editing annotations validated in prototype and documented in a11y checklist
Microcopy approved for empty state, annotation toast, and conflict resolution flows
Linked dev tasks created (ENG-xxxx) with clear UI spec and expected API shape examples in Confluence
comments: 2026-03-10 — Lena Cho: Initial ticket created after stakeholder sync 2026-03-09. Key outcomes: PMs want inline remediation actions; SREs want timeline pins for annotation context. Assigned to Aisha for visual system iteration. Attached initial figma.

2026-03-11 — Aisha Patel: Uploaded v0.2 frames focusing on annotation affordance and pinned timeline marker. Seeking feedback on whether annotation color should be modelled against severity or author role. Proposal: severity-based color with subtle role badge. @Marco Ruiz please confirm if ops prefers role-first labeling.
2026-03-11 — Marco Ruiz: Ops preference is severity-first for quicker triage; role badge useful but secondary. Also requested persistent link copy for incident ticketing (1-click link).

2026-03-11 — Devon Kim (PM): Requested microcopy variants for conflict resolution — two tone options (polite vs direct). Also requested copy for 'Resolve suggestion' CTA that integrates with runbooks.

2026-03-12 — Design review (internal): Visual redlines added for focus halos, token names included (token.*). Noted: focus ring thickness should match console global token 'focus-2' not 'focus-1' to match density mode. Action: update figma and export token sheet.

2026-03-12 — Accessibility review by Sofia Martinez: Ran contrast checks on badge colors; foreground/background combinations for 'flagged' state fail 4.5:1. Suggested palette adjustments and an optional outline for badge when in high-contrast mode. Added keyboard flow notes: annotation input should move focus to first field and trap until saved/canceled.

2026-03-12 — Aisha Patel: Implemented recommended palette tweaks in v0.3 and added a simplified keyboard flow prototype. Uploaded new frames and annotated expected CSS variables. Punted severity color scale expansion to follow-up (DES-47123).

2026-03-12 — Lena Cho: Consolidated feedback and requested a quick stakeholder signoff session on 2026-03-13. Drafted acceptance criteria and QA checklist. Note: link PRD and include API contract examples for dev to mock the annotation TTL and resolved flag behavior.

2026-03-12 — QA note (internal): Create test cases for annotation persistence across rollout window changes, behavior under canary rollback, and role-based visibility (owner vs collaborator). Include automated a11y tests in e2e harness.
decision_log: Use severity-based color scale for annotation prominence (decision 2026-03-11) — ops argued for faster visual triage.
Adopt 'focus-2' global token for inspector interactive focus states to align with condensed density mode (decision 2026-03-12).
Defer role-first color encoding to follow-up ticket to avoid scope creep; role indicated via badge and hovercard (decision 2026-03-12).
next_steps: Run stakeholder signoff 2026-03-13 and capture approval in Confluence
Export token sheet and hand off to ENG-20312 with annotated Figma frames
Create follow-up ticket for severity palette expansion (DES-47123) and for annotation API contract validation (ENG-xxxx)
Add QA tasks to cycle board and assign to QA engineer for cross-browser accessibility verification
notes_for_dev: Tokens provided in figma under page 'Tokens/Inspector' — use CSS variables prefixed with --rdw-inspector-
Expected states: idle, hover, active, editing, saved, resolved, conflict. See frame names in figma for exact spacing and z-index guidance.
Annotation model: { id, author, severity, text, created_at, expires_at (nullable), pinned_timestamp (optional), resolved_by (nullable) } — example shapes documented in Confluence as plain text
UX should gracefully handle long annotation text: clamp in timeline view with expand action that sets focus into annotation modal
